title: Kagerou Daze
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Shintaro Kisaragi has shut himself in his room for two years with only Ene, a mischievous program living in his computer. When his keyboard is ruined during the Obon holiday he must go out, walks into a department-store hostage situation, and is drawn into the Mekakushi Dan, a group of teens with eye-based powers that his sister belongs to, as the story moves between past and present over August 14 and 15 (Yen Press blurb; Outer Haven review; AniList tags).
life_message: Isolated, hurting young people find healing and purpose together as a chosen family.

content.note: Armed hostage-takers in volume 1 (Outer Haven; Yen Press blurb); no graphic violence described.
Tragic pasts, deaths and time loops (AniList Tragedy, Time Loop; MU Tragic Past, Dead Friend/s).
